title: Single violation: rebuy 11 days after a realized loss (wash sale, warning only)
notes: 200 sh SOFI sold at a realized loss (-500.00) on 2026-08-16, 11 days before as_of 2026-08-27 -- within the 30-day wash-sale window. R5 fires, but its severity is WARNING: it doesn't block and a resize can't fix a wash sale (the problem is the purchase timing, not the size), so it fires with disposition WARNED and the basket proceeds unchanged -- decision is ALLOW (not ALLOW_WITH_REPAIRS, since nothing was repaired; not BLOCK, since WARNING never blocks). 100 sh @ 8.00 = 800.00, 800/25000 = 3.2% of equity (cap 15%), no R3. Buying power 40000.00 covers 800.00, no R1. No day trade, no open orders, market open. Single rule fires.
